Prices, insurance & payment plans

Full price list in one place — no surprises. Final quotes are always confirmed after an examination, before treatment starts.

Itemized receipts0% plans over $500
Insurance, verified for you

We work with most major PPO plans. Send us your plan name in the chat and the front desk verifies your coverage before your visit — you only pay your share.

0% payment plans

Treatments over $500 can be split into monthly payments at 0% interest, agreed in writing before we start. No credit-card surcharge.

Clear quotes, in writing

Every treatment plan comes with an itemized quote. If anything changes mid-treatment, we stop and agree the new price with you first.
